synthetic_label: Every fixture is a SYNTHETIC structural/statistical design built from fixed patterns. It demonstrates software behavior only. It is not physical data, not fab data, and not a semiconductor simulation.
project_claim: The fixture expectations were preregistered before the evidence-check implementation was run against them.
preregistration_statement: This expectation was written before the WP2 evidence-check implementation existed and before any checker was run against this fixture.
decision_rule: REFUSE if any expected category has severity refuse; otherwise WARN if any has severity warn; otherwise ANALYZE. Notes never change the decision (D-048).
matching_rule: A fixture MATCHES when the actual decision equals expected_decision AND the set of actual finding codes equals the set expected_categories exactly (D-048).

check_areas.replication: replication at the treatment application level (S5)
check_areas.balance: balance and missing units checked from the data (S5)

declaration_refused.definition: The declaration does not match its claimed template under the WP1 rules; no data check runs.

missing_column.definition: A column named by the declaration (response, hierarchy ID, treatment or nuisance) is absent from the data.

missing_label.definition: An ID, treatment or nuisance cell is empty or NA, so the row cannot be placed in the design.

invalid_response.definition: A response cell is neither missing (empty or NA) nor a finite decimal number.

multiple_parents.definition: A label at an id_scope: global level occurs under more than one parent unit.

duplicate_observation.definition: Two rows carry the same tuple of all hierarchy ID values.

undeclared_level.definition: A treatment value, or a nuisance value of a factor with declared levels, is not a declared level.

treatment_not_constant.definition: A treatment takes more than one value within a unit of the level it was declared applied to.

nuisance_not_constant.definition: A nuisance factor takes more than one value within a unit of its recorded_at level.

subplot_structure.definition: T3: a subplot-factor (B) level occurs on more than one subplot unit of the same whole plot.

count_exceeds_declaration.definition: More present top-level units than declared, or a present parent with more present children than its count_per_parent.

missing_top_unit.definition: Fewer present top-level units than declared.

missing_intermediate_unit.definition: A present top-level unit has fewer present middle-level units than declared (three-level hierarchies).

missing_observation.definition: T1: a present lowest-level parent has fewer observations than declared.

missing_sites_not_exchangeable.definition: T2: lowest-level sites are missing and the lowest level is not declared exchangeable (explicitly false or by default).

missing_subplot_cell.definition: T3: subplot cells are missing and the missing B levels are not the same in every whole plot.

subplot_level_absent_everywhere.definition: T3: the same nonempty set of declared B levels is absent from every present whole plot.

positional_labels_inconsistent.definition: T1/T2: a non-exchangeable, parent-scoped nested level with exactly its declared count under every parent has different label sets under different parents.

insufficient_replication.definition: T2/T3: fewer than 2 present top-level units at some declared treatment (A) level.

unbalanced_units.definition: T2/T3: the numbers of present top-level units differ between declared treatment (A) levels.

block_imbalance.definition: T2 with a block: present-unit counts over declared treatment levels x declared block levels are not all equal.

complete_confounding.definition: A contrast of a declared comparison is not estimable once a nuisance factor is included (exact rank).

partial_confounding.definition: Every contrast is estimable, but the effect x nuisance count table is not proportional (v1 imbalance refusal).

aliased_components_required.definition: T1: two hierarchy levels partition the observations identically, so the separate components T1 must estimate are not identifiable.

missing_sites_exception.definition: T2: only lowest-level, declared-exchangeable sites are missing and every higher unit is present; the narrow exception applies (unit-mean analysis, unequal precision).

aliased_components.definition: T2/T3: two model terms partition the observations identically; only their combined component can be reported.

brown_forsythe.definition: Median-centered Brown-Forsythe test across treatment groups of unit means gives p < 0.05.

sd_ratio.definition: Largest-to-smallest treatment-group SD of unit means is >= 2.0, infinite, or undefined.

studentized_residual.definition: Some externally studentized residual in a diagnosed stratum has absolute value > 3.

aliased_partition.definition: Two grouping factors, at least one a recorded nuisance factor, partition the observations identically.

diagnostic_unavailable.definition: An applicable diagnostic could not be computed (sample size or degeneracy).

fixtures.purpose: A T2 declaration with one run per treatment level is refused at the WP1 stage, however many wafers and sites it has.
triggering_conditions: replicates_per_level: 1 fails WP1 condition T2.replicated
fixtures.rationale: D-038: T2 requires replicates_per_level >= 2 (r = 1 gives zero error df). S0 refuses before any data check (D-048). The data match the declaration, so no further finding is expected, and none is evaluated.
fixtures.preregistered: This expectation was written before the WP2 evidence-check implementation existed and before any checker was run against this fixture.

fixtures.purpose: A blank treatment label is refused, not guessed.
triggering_conditions: row run R03, wafer 2, site 2 has an empty temp cell
fixtures.rationale: D-048 S2: an empty or NA ID, treatment or nuisance cell cannot be placed in the design. S2 stops the pipeline, so no later finding is evaluated.
fixtures.preregistered: This expectation was written before the WP2 evidence-check implementation existed and before any checker was run against this fixture.

fixtures.purpose: A non-numeric response value is refused; it is not treated as missing.
triggering_conditions: row run R01, wafer 2, site 3 has response 'bad'
fixtures.rationale: D-043 reading 5: only an empty cell or NA is a missing response; anything else that is not a finite decimal is invalid. S2 stops the pipeline.
fixtures.preregistered: This expectation was written before the WP2 evidence-check implementation existed and before any checker was run against this fixture.

fixtures.purpose: A required declared column (the treatment column) is absent from the data.
triggering_conditions: declared treatment column 'temp' is not in the CSV header
fixtures.rationale: D-048 S1: every declared column must exist; the treatment of each unit is otherwise unknown. S1 stops the pipeline.
fixtures.preregistered: This expectation was written before the WP2 evidence-check implementation existed and before any checker was run against this fixture.

fixtures.purpose: Valid hierarchy: globally unique wafer IDs, each wafer under exactly one run.
triggering_conditions: none: 8 runs (4 per level) x 2 wafers W01-W16 (id_scope global) x 3 sites, complete
fixtures.rationale: Every structural check passes. The global wafer level is exempt from the label-balance rule (D-043 reading 3), and the site labels 1-3 are the same on every wafer. Diagnostics (D-044): run means in each level are (-1.5, -0.5, 0.5, 1.5) around the level mean, so the SD ratio is 1 and the Brown-Forsythe F is 0 (p = 1). The largest |externally studentized residual| is 1.46 by hand (h = 1/4, nu = 6).
fixtures.preregistered: This expectation was written before the WP2 evidence-check implementation existed and before any checker was run against this fixture.

fixtures.purpose: A child assigned to two parents: global wafer ID W02 occurs under runs R01 and R02.
triggering_conditions: wafer label W02 (id_scope global) under R01 and R02
fixtures.rationale: Brief WP2: each wafer belongs to exactly one run. D-036: global labels are unique across parents. The full ID tuples (R01, W02, s) and (R02, W02, s) differ, so it is not a duplicate observation. S3 stops the pipeline.
fixtures.preregistered: This expectation was written before the WP2 evidence-check implementation existed and before any checker was run against this fixture.

fixtures.purpose: Duplicate unit identity: the T1 observation L2/1/2 is recorded twice.
triggering_conditions: two rows with (lot, wafer, site) = (L2, 1, 2)
fixtures.rationale: D-048 S3: two rows with the same ID tuple make the observation's identity ambiguous. Stratum does not average or drop either row (D-047). S3 stops the pipeline.
fixtures.preregistered: This expectation was written before the WP2 evidence-check implementation existed and before any checker was run against this fixture.

fixtures.purpose: Hierarchy inconsistent with the declaration: 2 wafers per run declared, 3 in the data.
triggering_conditions: every run has 3 present wafers; count_per_parent is 2
fixtures.rationale: D-047: declared counts are expectations the data must meet; the declaration is never rewritten from the data. Nothing else is wrong: the runs, the per-level replication and the sites per wafer are as declared. There is no nuisance factor, and no two hierarchy levels partition the observations identically. Diagnostics are not evaluated after a refusal (D-044 reading 5).
fixtures.preregistered: This expectation was written before the WP2 evidence-check implementation existed and before any checker was run against this fixture.

fixtures.purpose: Valid treatment constancy in a two-level T2: treatment applied to wafers and constant within each wafer.
triggering_conditions: none: 6 wafers (3 per level) x 4 sites, complete, sites 1-4 on every wafer
fixtures.rationale: All structural checks pass (D-038 allows wafer > site). Diagnostics: wafer means (-1, 0, 1) around each level mean give an SD ratio of 1 and a Brown-Forsythe F of 0, with a nonzero within-group term. The largest |t| is 1.34 by hand (h = 1/3, nu = 4).
fixtures.preregistered: This expectation was written before the WP2 evidence-check implementation existed and before any checker was run against this fixture.

fixtures.purpose: The treatment changes inside a unit it was declared applied to.
triggering_conditions: run R02 has temp 'low' on wafer 1 and 'high' on wafer 2
fixtures.rationale: Brief WP2: a run-level treatment is constant within each run. With two values, the run's treatment is undefined. S4 stops the pipeline.
fixtures.preregistered: This expectation was written before the WP2 evidence-check implementation existed and before any checker was run against this fixture.

fixtures.purpose: An observed treatment level that was not declared.
triggering_conditions: run R07 has temp 'medium'; declared levels are low and high
fixtures.rationale: D-048 S4: data values must be declared levels. The value is constant within R07, so the only S4 finding is the undeclared level. S4 stops the pipeline, so the resulting 4/3 split of runs is not evaluated.
fixtures.preregistered: This expectation was written before the WP2 evidence-check implementation existed and before any checker was run against this fixture.

fixtures.purpose: A run-level nuisance factor varies within a run.
triggering_conditions: run R03 has chamber B on wafer 1 and A on wafer 2; chamber recorded_at run
fixtures.rationale: D-048 S4: a factor declared constant at a level must be constant within its units, or its confounding check is undefined. S4 stops the pipeline.
fixtures.preregistered: This expectation was written before the WP2 evidence-check implementation existed and before any checker was run against this fixture.

fixtures.purpose: Valid replication: 3 independent runs per treatment level.
triggering_conditions: none: r = 3 present runs per level, as declared
fixtures.rationale: r >= 2 at the application level (D-047). Diagnostics: run means (-1, 0, 1) in each level give an SD ratio of 1 and a Brown-Forsythe F of 0, with a nonzero within term. The largest |t| is 1.34 (h = 1/3, nu = 4).
fixtures.preregistered: This expectation was written before the WP2 evidence-check implementation existed and before any checker was run against this fixture.

fixtures.purpose: Pseudo-replication: one run per level carrying 6 wafers x 5 sites (60 observations), against a declaration of 3 runs per level.
triggering_conditions: 2 present runs against 6 declared
r = 1 present run at each level
fixtures.rationale: D-047: r is counted where the treatment was applied (runs). Lower-level wafers and sites cannot raise it. The two levels have equal r (1 and 1), so the units are not unbalanced. Each run has 6 wafers x 5 sites as declared, so no lower-level code is expected.
fixtures.preregistered: This expectation was written before the WP2 evidence-check implementation existed and before any checker was run against this fixture.

fixtures.purpose: Valid balanced T1: 4 lots x 3 wafers x 3 sites.
triggering_conditions: none: complete, labels identical under every parent
fixtures.rationale: The data meet every declared count. The non-exchangeable wafer and site levels (default false, parent scope) carry identical label sets, so label balance holds (D-043 reading 3). Diagnostics (D-044 reading 1): Brown-Forsythe and the SD ratio are not applicable to T1. Lot means (-1.5, -0.5, 0.5, 1.5) under an intercept-only model give a largest |t| of 1.73 by hand (h = 1/4, nu = 3).
fixtures.preregistered: This expectation was written before the WP2 evidence-check implementation existed and before any checker was run against this fixture.

fixtures.purpose: Unbalanced top-level treatment units: 5 'low' runs and 3 'high' runs (8 runs as declared).
triggering_conditions: r_low = 5, r_high = 3
fixtures.rationale: D-047: balance is checked from the data. The total of 8 runs equals the declared count, so no unit is missing or extra. min r = 3 >= 2, so replication is sufficient. Only the unequal split remains: unit-level imbalance, which v1 refuses (brief Section 5.4).
fixtures.preregistered: This expectation was written before the WP2 evidence-check implementation existed and before any checker was run against this fixture.

fixtures.purpose: A whole experimental unit is missing: 'high' run R08 is absent.
triggering_conditions: 7 present runs against 8 declared
r_low = 4, r_high = 3
fixtures.rationale: D-016/D-043: missing whole experimental units are refused, and the levels become unequal. min r = 3, so replication is sufficient.
fixtures.preregistered: This expectation was written before the WP2 evidence-check implementation existed and before any checker was run against this fixture.

fixtures.purpose: An intermediate unit is missing (wafer 2 of run R05), even though sites are declared exchangeable.
triggering_conditions: run R05 has 1 present wafer; count_per_parent is 2
fixtures.rationale: D-016/D-043: an entirely missing wafer is not covered by the missing-site exception. The sites under present wafers are complete, so no site-level code applies. The wafer label rule is not applied because not every run has its full wafer count (D-043 reading 3).
fixtures.preregistered: This expectation was written before the WP2 evidence-check implementation existed and before any checker was run against this fixture.

fixtures.purpose: Unequal child counts outside the exception: run R02 has 3 wafers and run R06 has 1 (2 declared).
triggering_conditions: R02: 3 present wafers > 2
R06: 1 present wafer < 2
fixtures.rationale: D-047: an excess and a shortfall at the intermediate level are both reported. Nothing is padded or dropped. The sites per wafer are complete. The runs and their per-level counts are as declared.
fixtures.preregistered: This expectation was written before the WP2 evidence-check implementation existed and before any checker was run against this fixture.

fixtures.purpose: T3 with 12 whole plots as declared but 4/2/3/3 per etch level.
triggering_conditions: whole plots per etch level 4, 2, 3, 3
fixtures.rationale: D-047: T3 whole plots per A level must be equal. The total of 12 matches the declaration, min = 2 >= 2, and every whole plot has positions 1-4 once each.
fixtures.preregistered: This expectation was written before the WP2 evidence-check implementation existed and before any checker was run against this fixture.

fixtures.purpose: T2 narrow exception: exchangeable lowest-level sites missing sporadically, every run and wafer present.
triggering_conditions: site 3 absent on R02/1, R05/2, R07/1 (4 of 5 sites remain)
sites declared exchangeable: true
all 8 runs and 16 wafers present
fixtures.rationale: D-016, D-043: the exception applies, which is a warning for unequal precision of unit means. The removed sites have deviation 0, so the hierarchical run means equal the complete-design means. The diagnostics are those of the r = 4 base: SD ratio 1, Brown-Forsythe F = 0, largest |t| 1.46. They add no code.
fixtures.preregistered: This expectation was written before the WP2 evidence-check implementation existed and before any checker was run against this fixture.

fixtures.purpose: T2 with fixed (declared nonexchangeable) positions missing sporadically.
triggering_conditions: same three missing sites as MISS-01
sites declared exchangeable: false
fixtures.rationale: D-022, D-028, D-043: the exception requires declared exchangeable sites. Fixed positions are refused. The label-balance rule is not applied, because the counts are incomplete (D-043 reading 3).
fixtures.preregistered: This expectation was written before the WP2 evidence-check implementation existed and before any checker was run against this fixture.

fixtures.purpose: T2 whose declaration is silent on exchangeability, with missing sites (D-022 case d).
triggering_conditions: same missing sites as MISS-01
exchangeable omitted (default false)
fixtures.rationale: D-022, D-037: exchangeability defaults to false and is never inferred, so the exception does not apply.
fixtures.preregistered: This expectation was written before the WP2 evidence-check implementation existed and before any checker was run against this fixture.

fixtures.purpose: T2 with fixed positions where exactly the same position (3) is missing from every wafer (D-028 case e).
triggering_conditions: position 3 absent on all 16 wafers
sites declared exchangeable: false
declaration still states 5 sites per wafer
fixtures.rationale: D-028: fixed positions are refused under the exception even when the same positions are missing everywhere. Stratum does not silently re-declare a reduced design (D-043 reading 1).
fixtures.preregistered: This expectation was written before the WP2 evidence-check implementation existed and before any checker was run against this fixture.

fixtures.purpose: Declared exchangeable, count-balanced reduction (D-028 case f): the declaration states 4 sites per wafer, each wafer has 4, and the labels differ arbitrarily between wafers.
triggering_conditions: 4 sites per wafer as declared; label sets differ (e.g. {2,3,4,5}, {1,3,4,5})
sites declared exchangeable: true
fixtures.rationale: D-022/D-028: for declared exchangeable sites, equal counts suffice and labels have no meaning. The label-balance rule applies only to nonexchangeable levels (D-043 reading 3). The four site deviations (-0.2, -0.1, 0.1, 0.2) sum to 0, so the diagnostics equal the r = 4 base: no code.
fixtures.preregistered: This expectation was written before the WP2 evidence-check implementation existed and before any checker was run against this fixture.

fixtures.purpose: Declared fixed positions where the counts happen to match the declaration (4 per wafer) but different positions were measured on different wafers (D-022 case c).
triggering_conditions: sites declared exchangeable: false
every wafer has exactly 4 sites, but the label sets differ between wafers
fixtures.rationale: D-022 (C-2) and D-043 reading 3: for nonexchangeable positions, matching counts are not enough. Different wafers measured different fixed positions, which can bias the contrast (policy_checks.py check 2). Exchangeability is never inferred from equal counts.
fixtures.preregistered: This expectation was written before the WP2 evidence-check implementation existed and before any checker was run against this fixture.

fixtures.purpose: Exchangeable sites with equal surviving counts but different arbitrary labels, while the declaration still states 5 sites per wafer.
triggering_conditions: every wafer has 4 of 5 declared sites
label sets differ between wafers
sites declared exchangeable: true
fixtures.rationale: D-043 reading 2: the different labels are consistent with exchangeability, but the declared count is not met. The case is classified under the narrow exception, every unit having the same site-variance factor F_site = 5/4, and is not silently re-declared. The unit means equal the base means, so the diagnostics add no code.
fixtures.preregistered: This expectation was written before the WP2 evidence-check implementation existed and before any checker was run against this fixture.

fixtures.purpose: T1 with sporadic missing observations (two rows absent).
triggering_conditions: L2/wafer 1 and L4/wafer 3 each have 2 of 3 sites
fixtures.rationale: D-016/D-043: sporadic missing observations in T1 are refused. The exception is T2 only (D-021, C-1). Every lot and wafer is present. No two levels partition identically, because the other wafers keep 3 sites.
fixtures.preregistered: This expectation was written before the WP2 evidence-check implementation existed and before any checker was run against this fixture.

fixtures.purpose: T1 with one response recorded as NA (missing response, not a missing row).
triggering_conditions: L1/2/2 response NA
fixtures.rationale: D-043 readings 4-5: NA is a missing response, not an invalid value. The observation is absent from the present data, so T1 refuses it as a sporadic missing observation.
fixtures.preregistered: This expectation was written before the WP2 evidence-check implementation existed and before any checker was run against this fixture.

fixtures.purpose: A genuinely balanced reduced T1, declared explicitly: 2 sites per wafer (labels 1 and 3 on every wafer).
triggering_conditions: none: declaration states 2 sites per wafer; data have sites 1 and 3 on every wafer
fixtures.rationale: D-016, D-043 reading 1: a reduced balanced T1 described by the declaration and the data proceeds. The site labels are the same under every wafer, so label balance holds. The lot means are as in BAL-01: largest |t| 1.73, and Brown-Forsythe and the SD ratio are not applicable.
fixtures.preregistered: This expectation was written before the WP2 evidence-check implementation existed and before any checker was run against this fixture.

fixtures.purpose: The same T1 data as MISS-10, but the declaration still states 3 sites: no reduced design is silently manufactured.
triggering_conditions: every wafer has 2 of 3 declared sites (site 2 absent everywhere)
fixtures.rationale: D-043 reading 1: the declaration's count is not met, and Stratum never rewrites the declaration. The refusal can say that a reduced declaration could be submitted.
fixtures.preregistered: This expectation was written before the WP2 evidence-check implementation existed and before any checker was run against this fixture.

fixtures.purpose: T3 with sporadic missing subplot cells.
triggering_conditions: W01 lacks position 2; W05 lacks position 3; other wafers complete
fixtures.rationale: D-016, D-021, D-043 reading 7: sporadic missing subplot cells in T3 are refused. The missing B-level sets differ between whole plots.
fixtures.preregistered: This expectation was written before the WP2 evidence-check implementation existed and before any checker was run against this fixture.

fixtures.purpose: A reduced balanced T3, declared explicitly with positions 1, 2 and 4, and the data have exactly those on every wafer.
triggering_conditions: none: b = 3 declared and present on all 12 whole plots
fixtures.rationale: D-016, D-021, D-043: a genuinely balanced reduced T3 with >= 2 subplot levels, described by its declaration, may be analyzed. Diagnostics by hand: whole-plot means (-0.5, 0, 0.5) per etch level give SD ratio 1, Brown-Forsythe F = 0 and largest |t| 1.27. The subplot residuals (+-0.25 on positions 1-2 of two wafers per level) give largest |t| 1.57 (h = 5/9, nu = 16).
fixtures.preregistered: This expectation was written before the WP2 evidence-check implementation existed and before any checker was run against this fixture.

fixtures.purpose: T3 declared with positions 1-4, but position 3 is absent from every wafer.
triggering_conditions: every whole plot lacks exactly {3}
fixtures.rationale: D-043 readings 1 and 7: the reduced T3 would be analyzable if declared (MISS-13), but this declaration lists position 3. It is refused, not silently reduced.
fixtures.preregistered: This expectation was written before the WP2 evidence-check implementation existed and before any checker was run against this fixture.

fixtures.purpose: A T3 reduced to only one B level in the data (declaration lists 4).
triggering_conditions: every whole plot has only position 1 (lacks {2, 3, 4})
one observation per whole plot: whole-plot and subplot partitions identical
fixtures.rationale: D-021 (C-3): with one remaining B level, B and AxB are not estimable. It is refused as T3 and never remapped to T2. Each whole plot keeps one observation, so the whole plots are present. Their partition then equals the subplot (residual) partition: two T3 model terms aliased, which is the D-046 warning code. It is reported alongside the refusal.
fixtures.preregistered: This expectation was written before the WP2 evidence-check implementation existed and before any checker was run against this fixture.

fixtures.purpose: A T3 declared with a single subplot level.
triggering_conditions: pos has 1 level: fails WP1 condition T3.subplot_complete
fixtures.rationale: D-021 (C-3), D-038: one B level is refused as T3 at the declaration stage and not reclassified.
fixtures.preregistered: This expectation was written before the WP2 evidence-check implementation existed and before any checker was run against this fixture.

fixtures.purpose: Structural missingness through responses: every response of wafer 1 of run R03 is NA, so the wafer is absent although its rows exist.
triggering_conditions: R03 has 1 present wafer (wafer 1 has no response)
sites declared exchangeable
fixtures.rationale: D-043 reading 4: a unit with no observed response is absent. A wholly missing wafer is outside the exception (D-016) even with exchangeable sites. The sites of present wafers are complete.
fixtures.preregistered: This expectation was written before the WP2 evidence-check implementation existed and before any checker was run against this fixture.

fixtures.purpose: The narrow exception in a two-level T2 (wafer > site): exchangeable sites missing on two wafers.
triggering_conditions: W02 and W05 have 4 of 5 sites
sites exchangeable: true
all 6 wafers present
fixtures.rationale: D-016/D-043: the sites are the lowest level, there is no intermediate level, and every experimental unit is present. The removed sites have deviation 0, so the wafer means are unchanged (-1, 0, 1 per level) and the diagnostics add no code (largest |t| 1.34).
fixtures.preregistered: This expectation was written before the WP2 evidence-check implementation existed and before any checker was run against this fixture.

fixtures.purpose: The exception does not apply when an experimental unit is also missing.
triggering_conditions: run R08 absent (r_high = 3)
one exchangeable site missing at R02/1
fixtures.rationale: D-016: every experimental unit must remain present for the exception. D-043 reading 6: the lost exchangeable site gets no separate code once the exception cannot apply. min r = 3, so replication is sufficient.
fixtures.preregistered: This expectation was written before the WP2 evidence-check implementation existed and before any checker was run against this fixture.

fixtures.purpose: No nuisance factor recorded; three treatment levels.
triggering_conditions: none
fixtures.rationale: With no nuisance factor there is nothing to confound. Diagnostics: run means (-1.5, -0.5, 0.5, 1.5) per level give SD ratio 1, Brown-Forsythe F = 0 and largest |t| 1.41 (h = 1/4, nu = 9).
fixtures.preregistered: This expectation was written before the WP2 evidence-check implementation existed and before any checker was run against this fixture.

fixtures.purpose: A balanced crossed block (chamber; 2 runs of each level in each chamber) is supported.
triggering_conditions: treatment x chamber counts [[2, 2], [2, 2]]
fixtures.rationale: D-045: a proportional (balanced) crossing gives variance ratio 1 and V = 0, which is not confounding. D-047: the block table is equal in every cell. Diagnostics (D-044, additive treatment + block model): residuals +-0.5, h = 3/8, nu = 5, |t| = 1. Unit means per level (-1.5, -0.5, 0.5, 1.5) give SD ratio 1 and Brown-Forsythe F = 0.
fixtures.preregistered: This expectation was written before the WP2 evidence-check implementation existed and before any checker was run against this fixture.

fixtures.purpose: Complete confounding with a recorded chamber, with many lower-level measurements (3 wafers x 5 sites per run).
triggering_conditions: every 'low' run in chamber A, every 'high' run in chamber B
fixtures.rationale: D-045: with chamber indicators in the run-level design, high - low lies outside the row space (rank test). It is not estimable, so REFUSE. The 120 observations cannot restore the missing information. Cramer's V = 1 is reported but is not the reason.
fixtures.preregistered: This expectation was written before the WP2 evidence-check implementation existed and before any checker was run against this fixture.

fixtures.purpose: Complete confounding through nesting: 'low' runs in chambers A and B, 'high' runs in C and D. The partitions are not identical, and rank still detects it.
triggering_conditions: each chamber contains one treatment level only (2 runs per chamber)
fixtures.rationale: D-045: the treatment indicator is a sum of chamber indicators, so the contrast is not estimable. The chamber partition (pairs of runs) differs from the run partition, so the D-045 reading 8 exemption does not apply, and no aliasing finding arises.
fixtures.preregistered: This expectation was written before the WP2 evidence-check implementation existed and before any checker was run against this fixture.

fixtures.purpose: Partial confounding: 'low' has 3 runs in A and 1 in B; 'high' has 1 in A and 3 in B.
triggering_conditions: table [[3, 1], [1, 3]] is not proportional
contrast estimable
fixtures.rationale: D-045: estimable but imbalanced is partial confounding, which v1 refuses. Hand values: chi-square = 2, V = sqrt(2 / (8 x 1)) = 0.5. Adjusted information for high - low = sum_j n1j n2j / n.j = 3/4 + 3/4 = 3/2, so Var = 2/3 sigma^2. Unadjusted Var = 1/4 + 1/4 = 1/2 sigma^2. Variance ratio 4/3, SE inflation 1.1547.
fixtures.preregistered: This expectation was written before the WP2 evidence-check implementation existed and before any checker was run against this fixture.

fixtures.purpose: A recorded day strongly associated with the response (+3/-3) but balanced across the treatment does not destroy estimability.
triggering_conditions: treatment x day [[2, 2], [2, 2]]; day shifts the response by 6 units
fixtures.rationale: D-045: estimability, not correlation with the response, decides. The table is proportional, giving variance ratio 1 and V = 0. Day is recorded, not a model term, so the one-way diagnostics see run means (-3.5, -2.5, 2.5, 3.5) per level. That gives SD ratio 1, Brown-Forsythe F = 0 and largest |t| 1.19 (h = 1/4, nu = 6).
fixtures.preregistered: This expectation was written before the WP2 evidence-check implementation existed and before any checker was run against this fixture.

fixtures.purpose: A recorded day that is proportional but unequal (2 runs of each level on d1, 1 of each on d2) is not confounding.
triggering_conditions: table [[2, 1], [2, 1]] is proportional
fixtures.rationale: D-045 reading 6: n_ij n = n_i n_j holds in every cell, giving variance ratio exactly 1 and V = 0. Diagnostics are as in REP-01 (largest |t| 1.34).
fixtures.preregistered: This expectation was written before the WP2 evidence-check implementation existed and before any checker was run against this fixture.

fixtures.purpose: A nuisance factor recorded below the experimental unit (metrology tool per wafer) is completely confounded with the treatment.
triggering_conditions: every 'low' wafer measured on M1, every 'high' wafer on M2 (rows = wafers)
fixtures.rationale: D-045 reading 2: the rows are wafers, the finer of the two levels, and the contrast is not estimable. The tool partition (two groups of 6 wafers) is not identical to any hierarchy partition, so neither the exemption nor an aliasing finding applies.
fixtures.preregistered: This expectation was written before the WP2 evidence-check implementation existed and before any checker was run against this fixture.

fixtures.purpose: Two recorded batch steps with identical groupings of the wafers but different labels (K1/K2 vs A-x/A-y).
triggering_conditions: clean_batch and anneal_batch induce the same partition of observations
fixtures.rationale: D-046: partition equivalence is detected whatever the labels. Both factors are recorded, not model terms, so the result is a note, not a warning. Each batch holds 4 'low' and 4 'high' wafers, a proportional table, so there is no confounding. Diagnostics are as for the r = 4 base (largest |t| 1.46).
fixtures.preregistered: This expectation was written before the WP2 evidence-check implementation existed and before any checker was run against this fixture.

fixtures.purpose: Two recorded batch steps with different groupings are not aliased.
triggering_conditions: anneal_batch regroups wafers relative to clean_batch
fixtures.rationale: D-046: different partitions mean no alias. Both batch tables against the treatment are [[4, 4], [4, 4]], proportional. Diagnostics are as for the r = 4 base.
fixtures.preregistered: This expectation was written before the WP2 evidence-check implementation existed and before any checker was run against this fixture.

fixtures.purpose: Aliasing that affects only separability: one wafer per run (w = 1), so run and wafer group the observations identically; the treatment comparison is unaffected.
triggering_conditions: run and wafer partitions identical (w = 1)
fixtures.rationale: D-046: both are T2 model terms. The treatment is tested on run means and stays estimable, but only a combined run+wafer component can be reported, so WARN. D-038 allows w = 1. Diagnostics are as for the r = 4 base.
fixtures.preregistered: This expectation was written before the WP2 evidence-check implementation existed and before any checker was run against this fixture.

fixtures.purpose: Requested inference that needs an impossible separation: a T1 declared with 2 sites per wafer whose data have 1 site per wafer.
triggering_conditions: every wafer has 1 of 2 declared sites
wafer and site partitions identical
fixtures.rationale: D-046: T1's requested inference is the separate lot, wafer and site components. With one observation per wafer, the wafer and site components cannot be separated, so REFUSE. D-043: the missing observations are refused as well. Both reasons are reported (D-048).
fixtures.preregistered: This expectation was written before the WP2 evidence-check implementation existed and before any checker was run against this fixture.

fixtures.purpose: A recorded boat that is different for every run only relabels the experimental units.
triggering_conditions: boat partition identical to the run partition (B1-B8)
fixtures.rationale: D-045 reading 8: a nuisance factor identical to a hierarchy level at or below the application level is aliased with that random level. It is excluded from the estimability test, so this is not complete confounding. D-046: boat is recorded, so the result is a note. Diagnostics are as for the r = 4 base.
fixtures.preregistered: This expectation was written before the WP2 evidence-check implementation existed and before any checker was run against this fixture.

fixtures.purpose: Benign diagnostics: equal spread, 5 runs per level.
triggering_conditions: none
fixtures.rationale: Run means (-2, -1, 0, 1, 2) in both levels give SD ratio exactly 1 and Brown-Forsythe F = 0 (p = 1, within term nonzero). The largest |t| is 1.53 by hand (h = 1/5, nu = 8).
fixtures.preregistered: This expectation was written before the WP2 evidence-check implementation existed and before any checker was run against this fixture.

fixtures.purpose: Variance imbalance across treatment levels: unit-mean SD 4x larger under 'high' (variance ratio 16).
triggering_conditions: SD ratio 4 >= 2
Brown-Forsythe F = 8.93 on (1, 10), p ~ 0.014 < 0.05
fixtures.rationale: D-044, by hand: absolute deviations from the medians have group means 1.5 and 6, so F = 60.75 / 6.8 = 8.93. A numerical integral of the F(1, 10) density gives p ~ 0.0136. The largest |t| is 2.47 (h = 1/6, nu = 10), which is not > 3. The structure is valid, so only the two diagnostic warnings arise.
fixtures.preregistered: This expectation was written before the WP2 evidence-check implementation existed and before any checker was run against this fixture.

fixtures.purpose: One outlying run in each level gives a studentized residual > 3, with equal spread between levels.
triggering_conditions: externally studentized residual of the outlying runs = sqrt(13) = 3.61 > 3
fixtures.rationale: D-044 reading 2, by hand: e = 3.5, s^2 = 2, h = 1/8, nu = 14 give r^2 = 7 and t^2 = 7 x 13 / 7 = 13. The internal residual sqrt(7) = 2.65 would not flag it. Both levels have the same pattern, so SD ratio 1 and Brown-Forsythe F = 0 (median-centered deviations (0 x 7, 4) in both levels).
fixtures.preregistered: This expectation was written before the WP2 evidence-check implementation existed and before any checker was run against this fixture.

fixtures.purpose: Diagnostic-unavailable edge case: 2 runs per level make Brown-Forsythe degenerate.
triggering_conditions: r = 2: both absolute deviations from each median are equal, so the within-group sum of squares is 0
fixtures.rationale: D-044 reading 3: Brown-Forsythe is reported unavailable, a note, without crashing or manufacturing a p-value. The SD ratio is 1. Studentized residuals are computable (nu = 2, |t| = 1). r = 2 meets replication, so ANALYZE.
fixtures.preregistered: This expectation was written before the WP2 evidence-check implementation existed and before any checker was run against this fixture.

fixtures.purpose: A treatment group whose unit means are identical (SD exactly 0) makes the SD ratio infinite.
triggering_conditions: SD('low') = 0, SD('high') > 0: ratio infinite
Brown-Forsythe F = 12 on (1, 6), p ~ 0.013
fixtures.rationale: D-044: a zero denominator SD is reported as infinite and warns. By hand, absolute deviations (0,0,0,0) and (1.5,0.5,0.5,1.5) give F = 2 / (1/6) = 12, p ~ 0.0134. The largest |t| is 2.74 (nu = 6), not > 3.
fixtures.preregistered: This expectation was written before the WP2 evidence-check implementation existed and before any checker was run against this fixture.

fixtures.purpose: Valid balanced T3: whole-plot and subplot structure consistent with the declaration.
triggering_conditions: none: 4 etch levels x 3 wafers x positions 1-4
fixtures.rationale: All structural checks pass. Whole-plot stratum: means (-0.5, 0, 0.5) per level give SD ratio 1, Brown-Forsythe F = 0 and largest |t| 1.27. Subplot stratum: residuals +-0.25 give largest |t| 1.81 (h = 1/2, nu = 24).
fixtures.preregistered: This expectation was written before the WP2 evidence-check implementation existed and before any checker was run against this fixture.

fixtures.purpose: The subplot factor (angle) varies incorrectly: it is constant within each wafer instead of taking each level once.
triggering_conditions: each wafer carries one angle level on all 4 positions
fixtures.rationale: D-047: in T3 each B level occurs once per whole plot. Here B is effectively a whole-plot factor, so the declared split-plot does not exist in the data. S4 stops the pipeline. Every angle value is a declared level.
fixtures.preregistered: This expectation was written before the WP2 evidence-check implementation existed and before any checker was run against this fixture.

fixtures.purpose: Missing whole-plot replication: one wafer per etch level against 3 declared.
triggering_conditions: 4 present whole plots against 12
r = 1 per etch level
fixtures.rationale: D-047: A is judged against whole plots. One per level gives zero df, and the 4 subplot readings per wafer do not count as whole plots. The levels are equal (1 each), so the units are not unbalanced.
fixtures.preregistered: This expectation was written before the WP2 evidence-check implementation existed and before any checker was run against this fixture.

fixtures.purpose: The whole-plot factor changes inside a whole plot.
triggering_conditions: wafer W02 has etch 1 on positions 1, 2, 4 and etch 2 on position 3
fixtures.rationale: D-048 S4: A is applied to whole plots and must be constant within each. S4 stops the pipeline.
fixtures.preregistered: This expectation was written before the WP2 evidence-check implementation existed and before any checker was run against this fixture.

fixtures.purpose: A subplot-stratum outlier: one reading +2 at W10 position 3.
triggering_conditions: subplot externally studentized residual ~ 7.8 > 3
fixtures.rationale: D-044 reading 1 (subplot stratum), by hand: the spike's residual is delta/2 = 1 with h = 1/2. SSE = 0.75 + 2 = 2.75 and nu = 24, giving r^2 = 17.45 and t ~ 7.83. Whole-plot stratum: level-4 means become (0, 0, 0.5), so the SD ratio is 1.73 < 2, Brown-Forsythe F = 0.25 (p ~ 0.86), and the largest |t| is 1.43. Only the subplot warning arises.
fixtures.preregistered: This expectation was written before the WP2 evidence-check implementation existed and before any checker was run against this fixture.

fixtures.purpose: A correctly balanced treatment x block crossing: 3 chambers, 2 runs of each level per chamber.
fixtures.rationale: D-047: the block table is equal in every cell. D-045: proportional, giving variance ratio 1. Diagnostics (additive treatment + block): residuals +-0.5, h = 1/3, nu = 8, |t| = 1. Unit means per level (-1.5, -0.5, -0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 1.5) give SD ratio 1 and Brown-Forsythe F = 0.
fixtures.preregistered: This expectation was written before the WP2 evidence-check implementation existed and before any checker was run against this fixture.

fixtures.purpose: A broken (unbalanced) block crossing: 'low' 3 in A, 1 in B; 'high' 1 in A, 3 in B.
triggering_conditions: block table [[3, 1], [1, 3]]
fixtures.rationale: D-047: the declared balanced crossing does not hold in the data. D-045: the contrast is estimable but the table is not proportional, so partial confounding (V = 0.5, variance ratio 4/3, as in CONF-05). Both are reported.
fixtures.preregistered: This expectation was written before the WP2 evidence-check implementation existed and before any checker was run against this fixture.

fixtures.purpose: The declared block is completely confounded with the treatment.
triggering_conditions: block table [[4, 0], [0, 4]]
fixtures.rationale: D-047: two empty cells are an unbalanced crossing. D-045: high - low is not estimable once chamber is in the model. The chamber partition (4 runs each) is not a hierarchy partition, so no exemption or aliasing finding applies.
fixtures.preregistered: This expectation was written before the WP2 evidence-check implementation existed and before any checker was run against this fixture.

reference_datasets.rationale: WP0 verified a complete 21 x 4 x 2 layout with zone labels 1-4 and wafer labels 1-2 under every parent (structure.json).

reference_datasets.rationale: Complete 8 x 3 x 3. Source is constant within lot and is a T1 recorded factor (no treatment, so no confounding check). Its partition (4 lots each) differs from the lot partition.

reference_datasets.rationale: Complete 30 x 3 x 5 with the same five site labels on every wafer (D-015).

vocabulary_amendments.definition: A recorded nuisance factor each of whose levels lies inside a single top-level unit (e.g. a different day for every run): as a category it cannot be separated from unit-to-unit variation; it is neither adjusted for nor called confounding or aliasing.

corrections.reason: Post-freeze specification clarification (D-053), not a preregistration match. Under the frozen rules D-045 reading 8 and D-046, the run-unique boat was reported as an aliased_partition note; the version-1 expectation ANALYZE {aliased_partition} matched the checker on the first full run (D-052). D-053 rules that a recorded factor with one unique level per experimental unit is not a grouping step and not confounding, and gets the warning nuisance_unit_unique instead. Under the clarified implementation the version-1 expectation no longer matches; version 2 records the outcome the clarified specification requires.
